    AI Overview
    Use this simple, non-ATS (Applicant Tracking System) job application template. It skips automated parsing in favor of a direct, human-readable format. You can copy this into an email, a PDF, or a lightweight builder like Jotform or AidaForm for a quick hiring setup. 
    Application for Employment
    1. Personal Details 
    • Full Name:
    • Phone Number:
    • Email Address:
    • Address (City, State, Zip):
    • Are you legally authorized to work in the country? [Yes / No] 
    2. Position Applying For 
    • Desired Job Title:
    • Available Start Date:
    • Desired Salary/Wage:
    • Employment Type Desired: [ ] Full-Time [ ] Part-Time [ ] Temporary 
    3. Work Experience
    Please list your most recent employer. 
    • Company Name:
    • Job Title:
    • Dates of Employment:
    • Brief Description of Duties: 
    4. Education 
    • Highest Level of Education (High School, College, etc.):
    • School Name:
    • Degree / Certification Obtained: 
    5. References
    Please list one professional reference. 
    • Name & Relationship:
    • Company & Phone Number: 
    6. Signature
    By submitting this application, I certify that the facts set forth in my application and resume are true and complete. 
    • Signature / Name:
    • Date: 
    If you would like to move forward, let me know:
    • What specific role or industry are you hiring for?
    • Would you prefer a Word/PDF printable version or a link to an online setup?
    I can help you format or host this exactly how you need.

    What is the 70 30 rule in hiring?
    What is the 70 30 rule in hiring? The 70 30 rule in hiring suggests that employers should hire candidates who meet 70% of the job requirements, accepting that the remaining 30% can be learned on the job.
